summary: Y-API is an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway with 48+ models. Its daily-key page issues one shared key per day funded by a $20 pool, refilled at 00:05 UTC; the shared pool can drain early, and keys stop working at the next rotation. Sign-in via GitHub or Google is required. Every catalog model works. Personal accounts separately get $1 starter credit, no card required. The service is unavailable to users in mainland China.
claim_steps: Confirm the service is available in your region (mainland China is excluded), then sign in to Y-API with GitHub or Google
Open https://y-api.bestvirtualgoods.com/daily-key and copy today's shared key and the Base URL shown
Point any OpenAI-compatible client at the Base URL with the key (OPENAI_BASE_URL / OPENAI_API_KEY)
